narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms developed along and south of I-40 due to diurnal heating during the late afternoon on July 4, 2023. Weak wind shear combined with deep moisture produced slow-moving, highly efficient rainfall-producing thunderstorms. There were several reports of flash flooding across the area.
ev: Several feet of water inundated Fairgrounds Road near the intersection with Highway 641.
Poplar Avenue and Scruggs Drive were completely underwater. Dogwood Creek subdivision was cut off from Poplar Avenue.
The road was flooded at the intersection of Tennessee Avenue and 9th Street. The water was one to two feet deep.
A road was flooded and closed near Cloverport. Vehicles were stranded.
